title: ClickAndCollectConfigurations
description: Per-business-unit settings for Click & Collect: how long to wait for a payment to complete, how orders are packed and prioritised, how home deliveries are shipped, and how the picking app reads barcodes and category menus.

bufferPeriodForCompletingPaymentInMinute.description: How long after an order is picked to wait for the customer to complete payment before the payment-initiation job picks it up.

defaultContainerType.description: Container the picking app suggests by default when packing an order.

highestVisibleItemCategoryLevel.description: Deepest category level shown in the picking app's category menu. Levels below this are not offered.

customerProfileIssuer.description: Issuer used to resolve the customer profile for an order. No default: unset means profiles are not resolved for this business unit.

urgentOrdersMaxValueForNotInProgress.description: Hours remaining before pickup at which an order that has NOT been started counts as urgent.

urgentOrdersMaxValueForInProgress.description: Hours remaining before pickup at which an order already being picked counts as urgent.

barcodeNumberFormat.description: Barcode format the picking app expects when scanning items. No default: unset means the app applies its own built-in handling.

doCaptureParcels.title: Capture parcels when packing home deliveries
doCaptureParcels.description: When true, the picking app asks for the parcels (how many, and an optional storage location per parcel) when packing a home-delivery-from-store fulfillment. Click & Collect stores them and passes them to Customer Order for the OMS/ERP. Nothing is booked with a carrier. Pickup-in-store orders are never affected.

doUseTmsShipping.title: Book home deliveries through TMS
doUseTmsShipping.description: When true, Click & Collect books the shipment and prints the labels through TMS for home-delivery-from-store fulfillments that carry a TMS delivery choice. For those fulfillments this implies parcel capture: the parcel step is shown even when doCaptureParcels is false. Fulfillments without a TMS delivery choice are not booked and get a parcel step only when doCaptureParcels is true.
